post:
Want to know how tumor genetics are analyzed in Saudi Arabia?

The targeted gene panel uses NGS to profile tumor DNA and identify actionable somatic mutations.
Testing is performed at King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre in Riyadh as a 1‑day outpatient service.
The package includes DNA extraction, sequencing, bioinformatic analysis and a standard molecular pathology report.

Read the full guide:
https://www.placidway.com/package/8685/Oncology-Targeted-Gene-Panel-Testing-NGS-Package-in-Riyadh-Saudi-Arabia-at-KFSHRC
